title: Trustworthy Runtime Error Healing in Real-World Repositories: A Benchmark and Guardrail
title_zh: 真实世界代码仓库中可信的运行时错误修复：基准与护栏

paragraphs.en: Runtime error healing lets a crashed program continue by generating code that repairs its live runtime state. Recent work shows that LLMs can generate such healing code, but it is evaluated only on small competition programs, and executing LLM-generated code inside a live process raises safety concerns that remain unaddressed. In this paper, we take LLM-based runtime healing toward practical use in real-world repositories. We first build HealBench, a benchmark of 265 runtime errors from 18 real-world repositories, each paired with a reference execution on the patched version. HealBench also provides a unified framework that lets LLM agents heal with cross-file context and live runtime state. We then design HealGuard, which requires healing code to be written in HealCore, an analyzable subset of Python, and uses static and dynamic taint analysis to check whether state changed by healing reaches operations protected by developers. We evaluate a dedicated healing method and three general coding agents with three backbone LLMs. The best setting resumes execution in 38.11% of instances and passes the target test in 28.68%, showing that existing agents can already heal a meaningful share of real repository-level crashes. However, among executions that pass, HealGuard flags 17.4% whose healing-changed state may reach a protected operation. On 684 controlled cases, HealGuard detects all unsafe cases, at the cost of a 68.42% false positive rate.

paragraphs.en: Runtime errors, such as KeyError and ValueError , remain a source of execution failures despite static analysis, software testing, and exception handling. When an error lacks appropriate handling logic, execution stops, and completed work may be lost. In a long-running service, one unhandled error can also take down every request the process is serving. For example, in vLLM before version 0.12.0, a single request carrying a crafted 1 × \times 1 image to a model built on the Idefics3 vision implementation causes the image processor to misread the image layout. The resulting tensor shape mismatch raises an unhandled runtime error that terminates the whole server, dropping all concurrent requests until it restarts ( vLLM Project, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在静态分析、软件测试和异常处理，运行时错误（如 KeyError 和 ValueError）仍然是执行失败的一个原因。 当错误缺乏适当的处理逻辑时，执行会停止，已完成的工作也可能丢失。 在长期运行的服务中，一个未处理的错误也可能导致该进程正在服务的每一个请求都中断。 例如，在 vLLM 0.12.0 版本之前，单个包含经过特殊构造的 1 × 1 图像的请求，如果发送给基于 Idefics3 视觉实现构建的模型，会导致图像处理器错误地读取图像布局。 由此产生的张量形状不匹配会引发一个未处理的运行时错误，从而终止整个服务器，并丢弃所有并发请求，直到服务器重新启动（vLLM Project, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate runtime errors, early self-healing systems rely on predefined recovery rules such as retries and checkpoint rollback ( Psaier and Dustdar, 2011 ; Carzaniga et al., 2013 ) , so they can only handle failures that were anticipated in advance. More recently, Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) removes this limitation. When a runtime error pauses the program, Healer asks an LLM to generate healing code from the error information, source code, and runtime state, and then runs that code inside the paused process. In the vLLM case above, for instance, an LLM could see from the runtime state that the tensor shapes do not match, reject only the malformed request with an error response, and thereby saving the server from crash. Healer’s results show that LLMs can heal a meaningful share of runtime errors that developers did not anticipate.
paragraphs.zh: 为了减少运行时错误，早期的自愈系统依赖预定义的恢复规则，例如重试和检查点回滚（Psaier and Dustdar, 2011；Carzaniga et al., 2013），因此它们只能处理事先预料到的故障。 近期，Healer（Sun et al., 2026）消除了这一限制。 当运行时错误导致程序暂停时，Healer会请求一个大型语言模型根据错误信息、源代码和运行状态生成修复代码，然后在暂停的流程中执行该代码。 例如，在上述vLLM的案例中，大型语言模型可以从运行状态中识别出张量形状不匹配的问题，仅对格式错误的请求返回错误响应，从而避免服务器崩溃。 Healer的实验结果表明，大型语言模型能够修复一部分开发者未曾预料到的运行时错误。

paragraphs.en: However, Healer is evaluated on small, self-contained competition programs, and moving to real-world repositories raises new challenges for both recovery and safety. Repository-level healing requires context spanning multiple files, and a single execution may encounter successive crashes, with each healing attempt starting from the state left by earlier attempts. More importantly, the effects of healing can extend beyond the error it resolves. LLM-generated healing code runs with the privileges of the current process, and its state changes may affect subsequent file writes, command execution, and validation checks. For example, an agent responding to an EOFError in Pillow can enable a global option that allows truncated images to be loaded. This permits execution to continue, but the same option also causes some subsequent image-integrity checks to be skipped. Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) acknowledges safety concerns but does not provide a mechanism to check or constrain these effects. Repository-level healing therefore requires examining whether its effects on subsequent execution respect the intended safety constraints, even when the target test passes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，Healer 是在小型、自包含的竞争程序中进行评估的，而转向真实世界代码库则为恢复和安全带来了新的挑战。 代码库级别的修复需要跨越多个文件上下文，单次执行可能会遇到连续崩溃，每次修复尝试都需从先前尝试留下的状态开始。 更重要的是，修复的影响可能超出其解决的问题范围。 LLM 生成的修复代码以当前进程的权限运行，其状态变化可能会影响后续的文件写入、命令执行和验证检查。 例如，一个响应 Pillow 中 EOFError 的智能体可能会启用一个全局选项，允许加载截断的图像。 这使得执行能够继续，但同一选项也会导致后续的一些图像完整性检查被跳过。 Healer（Sun et al., 2026）承认了安全方面的担忧，但未提供检查或限制这些影响的机制。 因此，代码库级别的修复需要检查其后续执行影响是否遵守预期的安全约束，即使目标测试通过了。

paragraphs.en: We also introduce HealGuard to examine the effects of healing on operations that developers choose to protect. Its central principle is to treat healing-generated values and state changes as untrusted and check whether they affect protected operations. This covers both operations performed directly by healing code and effects that propagate through subsequent execution. HealGuard represents values computed and locations modified by healing code as taint sources, and key inputs to protected operations as sinks. To support this analysis, we define HealCore, a restricted Python subset that excludes constructs such as dynamic code execution and reflection. HealGuard combines static analysis of potential source-to-sink paths with checks based on runtime events at protected operations. We evaluate its detection decisions on controlled cases and use offline analysis of recorded executions to assess its potential impact on healing.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Healer, mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, and Codex, each with three backbone LLMs, on HealBench. The best setting, Codex with GPT-5.6-Terra, continues to completion in 38.11% of instances and passes the test cases in 28.68%. This shows that existing agents can already heal a meaningful share of real repository-level crashes. However, passing the test does not mean that healing is safe. Across all 12 settings, 545 executions pass the test. HealGuard flags 95 of them (17.4%) because a value changed by healing may flow into a protected operation. In the cases we inspected, the healing code itself deletes a cache file or runs a subprocess, or it changes a setting that causes later validation checks to be skipped. To measure detection accuracy, we investigate 684 cases that contain protected operations after real heal points. In 342 of them, a value changed by healing reaches the protected operation, which is unsafe. HealGuard detects all 342 these unsafe cases (100.00% recall) with 59.38% precision.

paragraphs.en: We introduce HealBench, a repository-level runtime error healing benchmark with expected execution results and a unified framework for evaluating healing methods and coding agents.

paragraphs.en: We conduct an empirical study that distinguishes execution completion, target-test success, and the effects of healing on protected operations.

paragraphs.en: We introduce HealGuard and evaluate its detection decisions on controlled cases and recorded healing executions, characterizing both its detection capabilities and false positive costs.

paragraphs.en: Runtime Error Healing. Runtime error healing aims to resume interrupted execution within the current process. Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) primarily studies file-level healing, using an LLM to generate healing code from error information, source code, and runtime state, and executing it in the paused process. DaiFu ( He et al., 2025 ) recovers failed deep learning training jobs through developer-defined actions that update code, configuration, and runtime data. Other approaches address errors before failure: CatchAll ( Tao et al., 2026 ) and Seeker ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) add exception handling during development, while REDO ( Li et al., 2024 ) detects potential runtime errors without executing the program. Repository-level healing that requires cross-file context remains insufficiently explored. We evaluate whether LLM agents can combine this context with live runtime state to generate healing code.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时错误修复。 运行时错误修复旨在恢复当前进程中中断的执行。 Healer（Sun 等人，2026）主要研究文件级别的修复，利用大语言模型根据错误信息、源代码和运行时状态生成修复代码，并在暂停的进程中执行该代码。 DaiFu（He 等人，2025）通过开发者定义的操作来恢复失败的深度学习训练任务，这些操作会更新代码、配置和运行时数据。 其他方法则在错误发生前进行干预：CatchAll（Tao 等人，2026）和 Seeker（Zhang 等人，2024）在开发阶段添加异常处理机制，而 REDO（Li 等人，2024）则无需执行程序即可检测潜在的运行时错误。 需要跨文件上下文支持的仓库级别修复方法尚未得到充分研究。 我们评估了 LLM 智能体是否能够结合这种上下文与实时的运行时状态来生成修复代码。

paragraphs.en: LLM-Based Coding Agents. LLM-based coding agents use file reading, code search, shell commands, and code editing to understand and modify repositories through multi-step interactions ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; SWE-agent, 2025 ) . They support tasks such as software repair ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , software generation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and test generation ( Mündler et al., 2024 ) . These tasks primarily focus on source code, whereas the runtime error healing task we study also requires understanding and modifying live runtime state.

paragraphs.en: Program Analysis for Runtime Safety. Taint analysis tracks whether values from designated sources reach security-sensitive sinks. Static taint analysis identifies potential data-flow paths in program code ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Guo and Cai, 2026 ) , while dynamic taint analysis tracks marked values during execution ( Hough and Bell, 2025 ) . We apply this source-to-sink model to runtime error healing, combining static and dynamic analysis to examine whether state changes introduced by LLM-generated healing code can propagate to subsequent security-sensitive operations.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时安全程序分析。 污染分析用于追踪指定来源的值是否到达安全敏感的目标点。 静态污染分析可识别程序代码中潜在的数据流路径（Liu 等，2025；Guo 和 Cai，2026），而动态污染分析则在执行过程中追踪被标记的值（Hough 和 Bell，2025）。 我们将这一从源到目标的模型应用于运行时错误修复，结合静态与动态分析，检查由 LLM 生成的修复代码所引入的状态变化是否会传播至后续的安全敏感操作。

paragraphs.en: To address the issue that existing runtime error healing benchmarks lack a unified evaluation setting for real repositories ( Sun et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ) , we build HealBench to evaluate repository-level healing. HealBench contains runtime errors collected from real buggy repositories. It also provides a healing framework that reproduces each crash, executes healing code at the crash point, and continues program execution to evaluate the recovery result. This section presents the dataset construction, healing process, and evaluation methods.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决现有运行时错误修复基准测试缺乏针对真实代码库的统一评估设置的问题（Sun et al., 2026；He et al., 2025），我们构建了 HealBench，用于评估代码库级别的修复能力。 HealBench 包含了从真实存在错误的代码库中收集到的运行时错误。 它还提供了一个修复框架，能够重现每次崩溃，在崩溃点执行修复代码，并继续程序运行以评估恢复结果。 本节将介绍数据集的构建、修复流程以及评估方法。

paragraphs.en: Error Collection and Filtering. We focus on runtime errors in real-world repositories where the current process can pause at the crash point and execute healing code to resume execution. We select tasks with executable repository environments and reference patches from SWE-Bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . For each task, we run tests on the buggy version in its Docker environment and collect candidate errors, recording their types, messages, tracebacks, and crash points. We then run the same tests on the patched version and retain those that fail on the buggy version but pass on the patched version as target tests. We refer to each target test’s execution on the patched version as the patched run and use it as a reference for comparison with the corresponding execution with healing.
paragraphs.zh: 错误收集与过滤。 我们关注真实世界代码库中的运行时错误，在这些场景中，当前进程可以在崩溃点暂停，并执行修复代码以恢复执行。 我们从 SWE-Bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）、SWE-Bench Pro（Deng 等人，2025）和 R2E-Gym（Jain 等人，2025）中选取具有可执行仓库环境和参考补丁的任务。 对于每个任务，我们在其 Docker 环境中对存在错误的版本运行测试，收集候选错误，并记录它们的类型、消息、堆栈跟踪和崩溃点。 接着，我们对已打补丁的版本运行相同的测试，保留那些在错误版本中失败但在已打补丁版本中通过的测试作为目标测试。 我们将每个目标测试在已打补丁版本上的执行称为“已打补丁运行”，并将其用作与包含修复代码的相应执行进行比较的参考。

paragraphs.en: Construction Results. We collect 22,341 candidate errors from test executions. We exclude 17,435 errors that fall outside our runtime error healing setting, including test assertions and environment-related failures. We remove another 450 errors that prevent execution from resuming within the current process, including process termination and out-of-memory failures. We further exclude 4,178 errors that are duplicates or unrelated to the target bug. Manual review removes 13 additional instances, leaving 265 runtime errors in HealBench. Table 1 presents the distributions of error types and repositories across these 265 instances. TypeError , AttributeError , and ValueError account for 81.1% of the instances. The benchmark covers 18 repositories, with pandas and numpy accounting for 61.9% of the instances. As shown in Fig. 3 , the patched runs span a median of 37 files and 130 functions, demonstrating that the benchmark involves executions across multiple files and functions.
paragraphs.zh: 构建结果。 我们从测试执行中收集了 22,341 个候选错误。 我们排除了 17,435 个超出运行时错误修复设置范围的错误，包括测试断言和环境相关的失败。 我们又移除了 450 个导致当前进程无法恢复执行的其他错误，包括进程终止和内存不足导致的失败。 我们进一步排除了 4,178 个重复或与目标问题无关的错误。 通过人工审查又排除了 13 个实例，HealBench 中最终保留了 265 个运行时错误。 表 1 展示了这 265 个实例中错误类型和代码库的分布情况。 TypeError、AttributeError 和 ValueError 占这些实例的 81.1%。 该基准测试覆盖了 18 个代码库，其中 pandas 和 numpy 占这些实例的 61.9%。 如图 3 所示，经过修复的运行涉及中位数为 37 个文件和 130 个函数，表明该基准测试涵盖了跨多个文件和函数的执行过程。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , the framework consists of an execution side and a healing side, which run in separate environments and communicate over HTTP. The execution side runs the program and pauses execution when a runtime error is intercepted. The healing side analyzes the crash context and generates healing code. A unified interaction protocol allows different LLM agents to inspect runtime state and submit healing code.

Before execution, it instruments executable statements in the repository to intercept runtime errors. Fig. 3 shows an example, and Appendix A.1 provides the detailed instrumentation rules.

paragraphs.en: The instrumented program runs until a runtime error is intercepted. The execution side then pauses execution and sends the crash context to the healing side. This context includes the exception type and message, traceback, local variables, crash statement, and source code of the enclosing function.
paragraphs.zh: 经过仪器化的程序会一直运行，直到捕获到运行时错误。 执行端随后暂停执行，并将崩溃上下文发送到修复端。 该上下文包括异常类型和消息、堆栈跟踪、局部变量、崩溃语句以及包含该异常的函数的源代码。

paragraphs.en: After receiving healing code, the execution side runs it in a temporary variable environment that shares mutable objects with the paused execution. If the code completes successfully, variable bindings are written back to the current runtime state, and execution resumes. If the code fails, the execution side returns the error to the healing side for revision and retry. Changes to shared objects may take effect before the healing code completes, and neither these changes nor external side effects are automatically reverted after a failed attempt. Appendix A.1 provides the detailed rules.
paragraphs.zh: 收到修复代码后，执行方会在一个临时变量环境中运行该代码，该环境与暂停的执行共享可变对象。 如果代码成功执行完毕，变量绑定将被写回当前的运行时状态，然后执行将继续进行。 如果代码执行失败，执行方会将错误返回给修复方，以便进行修正并重新尝试。 对共享对象的修改可能在修复代码完成之前生效，并且无论这些修改还是外部的副作用，在尝试失败后都不会被自动撤销。 附录 A.1 提供了详细规则。

paragraphs.en: Agents use the crash context, repository code, and inspected runtime values to generate healing code. They can request additional runtime information before submitting a healing attempt and revise the code if execution returns an error. If they cannot generate reliable healing code, they stop healing and allow the original exception to propagate. Exceptions expected by the program should likewise be allowed to propagate to their intended handlers.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体利用崩溃上下文、仓库代码和已检查的运行时值来生成修复代码。 在提交修复尝试之前，它们可以请求额外的运行时信息，并在执行返回错误时修改代码。 如果无法生成可靠的修复代码，它们将停止修复，并允许原始异常继续传播。 程序预期发生的异常同样应被允许传播到其预定的处理程序中。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated healing code executes inside the running process, and its effects may extend beyond the crash point. We distinguish two forms of potentially unsafe behavior: (1) direct operations performed by healing code, such as deleting a cache file with os.remove or invoking a package installer through subprocess.run ; and (2) state changes that affect subsequent execution, such as setting ImageFile.LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES = True , which causes Pillow to skip some later input validation checks. Passing the target test does not rule out these effects. We formulate both cases as a taint analysis problem: healing introduces untrusted values that must not reach operations protected by developers.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 生成的修复代码在运行中的进程内部执行，其影响可能超出崩溃点。 我们将潜在不安全的行为分为两种形式：(1) 修复代码直接执行的操作，例如使用 os.remove 删除缓存文件，或通过 subprocess.run 调用包安装程序；以及 (2) 影响后续执行的状态变化，例如将 ImageFile.LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES = True，这会导致 Pillow 跳过后续的一些输入验证检查。 通过目标测试并不能排除这些影响。 我们将这两种情况都表述为一个污染分析问题：修复过程会引入不可信的值，这些值绝不应到达开发者受保护的操作中。

paragraphs.en: Safety Model. Developers declare a set P P of protected operations and a key input κ ⁡ ( o ) \kappa(o) for each operation o o . For operations with external effects, the key input is the argument that determines the effect, e.g., the path passed to os.remove . For security checks, it is the condition that determines whether the check is enforced, e.g., the test on ImageFile.LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES before a input check in Pillow. paragraphs.en: Overall Performance. We find that existing approaches present limited capability in runtime error handling. Across different combinations, the Proceed Rate ranges from 5.12% to 38.11%, while the Correct Rate ranges from 3.54% to 28.68%. The correct rate is lower than the proceed rate in every setting, showing that continuing execution does not ensure a correct result. For example, without HealGuard, Healer with GPT-5.6-Terra continues in 29.43% of instances but passes the target test in 16.98%. Healing can therefore remove the immediate failure while leaving runtime state that later code uses incorrectly. For the Vanilla rows, Trace Similarity ranges from 47.90% to 75.35%, showing differences between healed and patched execution paths. Matching more recorded execution points does not itself establish that the program produces the expected result.

paragraphs.en: Action Distribution. Fig. 5 shows the action distribution of different methods with GPT-5.6-Terra. Healer does not perform separate Explore and Inspect State actions, and most of its actions are Heal. The mini-SWE-agent mainly performs Heal and frequently uses Inspect State. OpenHands performs more Explore and Inspect State actions. Codex has the highest share of Reraise actions. These results show that healing methods use repository context and runtime state differently. Explore reads source code for cross-file context, while Inspect State checks values in the paused process. Healer lacks separate tools for these actions, so its zero shares reflect its interface. paragraphs.en: Overall Performance. Overall, HealGuard blocks all 342 unsafe cases in the controlled evaluation, achieving a 100% recall. High recall matters for automated runtime error healing, as releasing an unsafe healing attempt can cause irreversible side effects, whereas a wrongly blocked attempt could just fall back to raising the original exception. This recall comes at the cost of blocking 234 of the 342 safe cases (68.42% false positive rate). We consider this trade-off acceptable in this setting. By stage, static analysis blocks 177 of the 342 unsafe cases and 12 safe cases, achieving a 93.65% precision. Dynamic checking, applied to the 495 cases not blocked by static analysis, blocks the remaining 165 unsafe cases and 222 safe cases. Under this design, HealGuard could achieve a balance between effectiveness and efficiency, that the static analysis stage rejects easy cases before real execution, while dynamic checking catches the dependencies that the previous stage misses at the unsafe healing operations.
paragraphs.zh: 整体性能。 总体而言，HealGuard 在受控评估中拦截了全部 342 个不安全用例，实现了 100% 的召回率。 对于自动运行时错误修复而言，高召回率至关重要，因为执行一个不安全的修复尝试可能会造成不可逆的副作用，而错误拦截的尝试则可能只是重新抛出原始异常。 这一召回率的代价是拦截了 342 个安全用例中的 234 个（假阳性率为 68.42%）。 我们认为在此设定下，这种权衡是可以接受的。 按阶段来看，静态分析拦截了 342 个不安全用例中的 177 个以及 12 个安全用例，实现了 93.65% 的精确率。 动态检查则应用于静态分析未拦截的 495 个用例，并进一步拦截了剩余的 165 个不安全用例和 222 个安全用例。 在这种设计下，HealGuard 能够在有效性与效率之间取得平衡：静态分析阶段在真实执行前就拒绝了简单用例，而动态检查则能捕捉到前一阶段在 unsafe healing 操作中遗漏的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Case Study. Figure 6 shows a case in which static taint analysis returns unknown and dynamic taint checking blocks a protected operation. The program iterates over headers with for name, value in headers , but headers is a mapping, so each iteration yields only a key, and unpacking it raises a ValueError . The healing code iterates over headers.items() instead, builds each key as ’HTTP_’ + name , and writes the value to environ . After healing, the local variable key holds ’HTTP_X_TEST’ , so HealGuard records key as a Heal Source. Execution then continues to result = transform(key) and os.putenv(’APP_HEADER’, result) , where the value argument of os.putenv is a declared Sink. CodeQL cannot resolve how the return value of transform , imported from external_api , depends on its argument, so the static verdict is unknown and dynamic checking is enabled for this healing step. Before os.putenv executes, the wrapper cannot establish that result is independent of the Heal Source, and it blocks the call. The block is correct under the policy, because result is computed from the healed key . However, the decision comes from the conservative rule for unproven independence rather than from a matched dependency path.

paragraphs.en: We build HealBench to evaluate repository-level runtime error healing in real-world repositories and systematically study the recovery capability of existing LLM agents. HealBench provides real runtime errors, a unified healing environment, and recovery evaluation, enabling different healing methods to be compared under the same setting. To address the risk that runtime state modified by healing may propagate to high-risk operations, we further design HealGuard to detect and block unsafe healing. Overall, our study establishes a unified framework that connects repository-level runtime error healing evaluation with healing safety checks, providing a basis for building more reliable and safe self-healing systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建 HealBench，旨在评估真实世界代码库中的仓库级运行时错误修复能力，并系统性地研究现有 LLM 智能体的恢复能力。 HealBench 提供了真实的运行时错误、统一的修复环境以及恢复能力评估功能，使得不同修复方法能够在相同设置下进行比较。 为应对修复操作可能修改的运行时状态传播至高风险操作的风险，我们进一步设计了 HealGuard，用于检测并阻止不安全的修复行为。 总体而言，我们的研究建立了一个统一框架，将仓库级运行时错误修复的评估与修复安全性检查相结合，为构建更可靠、更安全的自修复系统提供了基础。

sents.en: HealBench provides real runtime errors, a unified healing environment, and recovery evaluation, enabling different healing methods to be compared under the same setting.
sents.zh: HealBench 提供了真实的运行时错误、统一的修复环境以及恢复能力评估功能，使得不同修复方法能够在相同设置下进行比较。

sents.en: To address the risk that runtime state modified by healing may propagate to high-risk operations, we further design HealGuard to detect and block unsafe healing.
sents.zh: 为应对修复操作可能修改的运行时状态传播至高风险操作的风险，我们进一步设计了 HealGuard，用于检测并阻止不安全的修复行为。

sents.en: Overall, our study establishes a unified framework that connects repository-level runtime error healing evaluation with healing safety checks, providing a basis for building more reliable and safe self-healing systems.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究建立了一个统一框架，将仓库级运行时错误修复的评估与修复安全性检查相结合，为构建更可靠、更安全的自修复系统提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: This work uses public open-source repositories and public benchmark tasks. It involves no human subjects or private user data. Runtime healing runs LLM-generated code inside a live process. Such code can delete files, start subprocesses, or print sensitive values, and we observed each of these in our experiments (Appendix D.4.1 ). We ran all healing inside per-instance Docker containers, and agents read the repository only through a read-only copy. HealGuard lowers this risk but does not remove it: it covers only declared protected operations and explicit data flow, and it has a high false positive rate. A passing target test does not show that healing is safe, so LLM-based healing should not be used in production without developer-declared protections and stronger isolation. Released records do not include access tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用了公共开源仓库和公共基准任务。 研究不涉及任何人类受试者或用户私有数据。 运行时修复会在一个正在运行的进程内部执行由大语言模型生成的代码。 此类代码可以删除文件、启动子进程或输出敏感值，我们在实验中观察到了这几种情况（附录 D.4.1）。 我们在每个实例的 Docker 容器内运行了所有修复操作，且智能体仅通过只读副本读取仓库。 HealGuard 降低了这一风险，但并未完全消除：它仅覆盖已声明的保护操作和明确的数据流，并且存在较高的误报率。 通过目标测试并不意味着修复是安全的，因此未经开发者声明的保护措施和更强的隔离机制，不应在生产环境中使用基于大语言模型的修复方法。 发布的记录中不包含访问令牌。

paragraphs.en: Agent Interaction and Continued Execution. The execution side runs the repository in Docker. The healing side runs outside the container, maintains a read-only repository copy, and communicates with the execution side through HTTP. Before execution, the framework inserts exception handlers around executable statements. Function and class declarations are not wrapped directly, but statements inside them are instrumented. A return expression is first evaluated into _eh_rtn so that its failure can be intercepted before the function returns.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体交互与持续执行。 执行端在 Docker 中运行该仓库。 修复端运行在容器外部，维护一个只读的仓库副本，并通过 HTTP 与执行端通信。 在执行之前，框架会在可执行语句周围插入异常处理程序。 函数和类声明不会被直接包裹，但其中的语句会被植入监控代码。 return 表达式会先被求值到 _eh_rtn，以便在函数返回前拦截其失败情况。

paragraphs.en: When a handler catches a runtime error, the execution side sends the crash context to the agent. Repository exploration reads source files, while probe code inspects live runtime state. The agent then submits healing code. Execution errors are returned for revision, and the agent can abandon healing by re-raising the original exception. The adapters expose different tools, as specified in Appendix F . After successful healing, execution continues after the injected handler rather than automatically retrying the failed statement. If the handler wraps a compound statement, continuation can skip unfinished work inside it. Later runtime errors start new interactions using the current runtime state.

paragraphs.en: State Updates and Boundaries. Healing code executes in a temporary variable environment built from shallow namespace copies. Updated bindings are written back after successful execution. Mutable objects remain accessible from the original process, so in-place changes can take effect before the code finishes. Failed submissions and probe code can therefore leave object changes and external side effects behind. Re-raising an exception and reaching a timeout do not roll back these effects. The special binding _eh_rtn supplies a direct return value from the current function.

paragraphs.en: Enforcement Conditions. Establishing the safety policy requires sufficient source recording, dependency models, Sink coverage, and trusted instrumentation. Labels need to remain available wherever the policy requires monitoring, including relevant propagation across execution boundaries. Checks need to act before protected side effects occur, including direct operations inside healing code and effects during argument evaluation. HealCore’s syntax gate alone does not establish these conditions for permitted callees. Healing code also needs to be prevented from modifying the checks and their records. The supplied predictions do not establish these enforcement conditions for the historical runs.
paragraphs.zh: 执行条件。 建立安全策略需要充分的源记录、依赖模型、目标覆盖和可信的仪器化。 在策略要求监控的任何地方，标签都必须保持可用，包括跨执行边界的传播。 检查必须在受保护的副作用发生之前执行，包括修复代码内部的直接操作以及参数求值期间的效应。 HealCore 的语法门本身无法为被调用项建立这些条件。 还必须防止修复代码修改检查及其记录。 所提供的预测并未为历史运行建立这些执行条件。

paragraphs.en: HealBench pairs runtime errors in real repositories with target tests and patched reference executions. Following Fig. 1 , we collect candidate errors, filter them and review the remaining cases, then record the final dataset and its execution characteristics.
paragraphs.zh: HealBench 将真实代码库中的运行时错误与目标测试以及经过修补的参考执行进行配对。 按照图 1 的流程，我们收集候选错误、对其进行过滤并审查剩余案例，然后记录最终数据集及其执行特征。

sents.en: HealBench pairs runtime errors in real repositories with target tests and patched reference executions.
sents.zh: HealBench 将真实代码库中的运行时错误与目标测试以及经过修补的参考执行进行配对。

sents.en: Following Fig. 1 , we collect candidate errors, filter them and review the remaining cases, then record the final dataset and its execution characteristics.
sents.zh: 按照图 1 的流程，我们收集候选错误、对其进行过滤并审查剩余案例，然后记录最终数据集及其执行特征。

paragraphs.en: We collect candidates from executable tasks in SWE-Bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . We retain each task’s repository version, execution environment, tests, and reference patch. We run the tests on the buggy version and record the exception type and message, traceback, and crash point. Each candidate remains linked to the repository version and test that triggered it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 SWE-Bench (Jimenez et al., 2024)、SWE-Bench Pro (Deng et al., 2025) 和 R2E-Gym (Jain et al., 2025) 中的可执行任务中收集候选智能体。 我们保留每个任务的仓库版本、执行环境、测试用例以及参考补丁。 我们在存在错误的版本上运行测试，并记录异常类型与消息、堆栈跟踪以及崩溃点。 每个候选智能体仍与其触发的仓库版本和测试用例保持关联。

sents.en: We collect candidates from executable tasks in SWE-Bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 我们从 SWE-Bench (Jimenez et al., 2024)、SWE-Bench Pro (Deng et al., 2025) 和 R2E-Gym (Jain et al., 2025) 中的可执行任务中收集候选智能体。

sents.en: We retain each task’s repository version, execution environment, tests, and reference patch.
sents.zh: 我们保留每个任务的仓库版本、执行环境、测试用例以及参考补丁。

sents.en: We run the tests on the buggy version and record the exception type and message, traceback, and crash point.
sents.zh: 我们在存在错误的版本上运行测试，并记录异常类型与消息、堆栈跟踪以及崩溃点。

sents.en: Each candidate remains linked to the repository version and test that triggered it.
sents.zh: 每个候选智能体仍与其触发的仓库版本和测试用例保持关联。

paragraphs.en: We then apply the reference patch and run the same tests. Tests that trigger the candidate runtime error on the buggy version and pass on the patched version become candidate target tests. Their passing runs provide the reference outcomes and execution paths. A passing patched test alone does not establish that the candidate error is related to the target bug, so we check that relation during filtering and manual review. Each retained instance links a runtime error, its target test, and the patched reference execution through its instance identifier.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们应用参考补丁并运行相同的测试。 在存在缺陷的版本中会触发候选运行时错误，但在已打补丁的版本中却能通过的测试，将成为候选目标测试。 这些测试通过运行可提供参考结果和执行路径。 仅凭一个通过测试的已打补丁测试，尚无法确定候选错误与目标缺陷是否存在关联，因此我们会在过滤和人工审查阶段验证这种关系。 每个保留的实例都通过其实例标识符，将某个运行时错误、其对应的目标测试以及已打补丁的参考执行过程关联起来。

sents.zh: 接着，我们应用参考补丁并运行相同的测试。

paragraphs.en: We retain runtime errors that arise from the target bug in repository code and leave the current process available for healing. The runtime setting follows Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , which executes healing code using state accessible at the crash point. Table 3 summarizes the exclusion rules. These rules describe the setting studied here, not failures that are impossible to heal in every environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留由目标错误在仓库代码中引发的运行时错误，并使当前进程可用于修复。 该运行时设置遵循 Healer（Sun et al., 2026），它使用崩溃点可访问的状态来执行修复代码。 表 3 总结了排除规则。 这些规则描述了本文研究的设置，而非在所有环境中都无法修复的故障。

sents.en: We retain runtime errors that arise from the target bug in repository code and leave the current process available for healing.
sents.zh: 我们保留由目标错误在仓库代码中引发的运行时错误，并使当前进程可用于修复。

sents.en: The runtime setting follows Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , which executes healing code using state accessible at the crash point.
sents.zh: 该运行时设置遵循 Healer（Sun et al., 2026），它使用崩溃点可访问的状态来执行修复代码。

sents.en: Table 3 summarizes the exclusion rules.
sents.zh: 表 3 总结了排除规则。

sents.en: These rules describe the setting studied here, not failures that are impossible to heal in every environment.
sents.zh: 这些规则描述了本文研究的设置，而非在所有环境中都无法修复的故障。

paragraphs.en: We first use the traceback to locate the error. We exclude errors in tests and third-party dependencies, together with failures caused by the execution environment, imports, and dependency mismatches. We also exclude assertions, warnings, syntax failures, and configuration failures before program execution. We then inspect the crash context and reference patch to check the relation to the target bug. Unrelated defects and expected exceptions are excluded. For example, an exception used to transfer control to an intended handler is not itself a bug that needs healing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先使用回溯法定位错误。 我们不考虑测试和第三方依赖中的错误，也不考虑由执行环境、导入和依赖不匹配引起的故障。 在程序执行之前，我们也不考虑断言、警告、语法错误和配置失败。 接着，我们检查崩溃上下文和参考补丁，以确认它们与目标缺陷的关联。 无关的缺陷和预期异常会被排除在外。 例如，用于将控制转移给预定处理程序的异常本身并非需要修复的缺陷。

sents.en: We first use the traceback to locate the error.
sents.zh: 我们首先使用回溯法定位错误。

sents.en: We exclude errors in tests and third-party dependencies, together with failures caused by the execution environment, imports, and dependency mismatches.
sents.zh: 我们不考虑测试和第三方依赖中的错误，也不考虑由执行环境、导入和依赖不匹配引起的故障。

sents.en: We also exclude assertions, warnings, syntax failures, and configuration failures before program execution.
sents.zh: 在程序执行之前，我们也不考虑断言、警告、语法错误和配置失败。

sents.en: We then inspect the crash context and reference patch to check the relation to the target bug.
sents.zh: 接着，我们检查崩溃上下文和参考补丁，以确认它们与目标缺陷的关联。

sents.en: Unrelated defects and expected exceptions are excluded.
sents.zh: 无关的缺陷和预期异常会被排除在外。

sents.en: For example, an exception used to transfer control to an intended handler is not itself a bug that needs healing.
sents.zh: 例如，用于将控制转移给预定处理程序的异常本身并非需要修复的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: The process also needs to remain alive with an accessible crash frame. Healing code needs to read and update runtime state in that process, and execution needs to continue afterward. Candidates without this access are excluded. These conditions establish that healing can be attempted, not that an LLM agent will produce correct runtime state.

paragraphs.en: We remove duplicates using source-instance identity and the pair of test name and error message. Matching exception types alone do not make candidates duplicates. We manually review the remaining candidates using the target test, traceback, crash context, and reference patch to assess the error’s location, bug relation, and suitability for runtime error healing. Checks of patch usability, dependencies, and migration validity support this review. Reviewer assignments, independent annotation, and adjudication are not inferred from the final instance list.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用源实例标识以及测试名称和错误消息的组合来移除重复项。 仅凭匹配异常类型并不能使候选项成为重复项。 我们手动审查剩余的候选项，借助目标测试、堆栈跟踪、崩溃上下文和参考补丁来评估错误的位置、与 bug 的关系以及是否适合运行时错误修复。 对补丁可用性、依赖关系和迁移有效性的检查为这一审查提供支持。 审查员的分配、独立标注和裁决并非从最终实例列表中推断得出。

paragraphs.en: Agent Interfaces. Healer accepts final submissions through execute with submit=true but has no separate probe, repository exploration, and agent-requested re-raising tools. mini-SWE-agent retains its native loop and bash tool and adds runtime inspection, submission, and re-raising tools. OpenHands retains its native prompt, appends common healing instructions, removes specified editor tools, and adds runtime actions. Codex uses a JSON response protocol and resumes the same conversation thread for later interactions. These tool differences are part of the method comparison, while model comparisons keep the adapter fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体接口。 Healer 通过 execute with submit=true 接受最终提交，但没有独立的探测、仓库探索以及智能体请求的重新提出工具。mini-SWE-agent 保留其原生循环和 bash 工具，并增加了运行时检查、提交和重新提出工具。 OpenHands 保留其原生提示，附加常见的修复指令，移除指定的编辑器工具，并增加运行时操作。 Codex 使用 JSON 响应协议，并在后续交互中恢复相同的对话线程。 这些工具差异属于方法比较的一部分，而模型比较则保持适配器不变。

paragraphs.en: Execution Environment. Each repository runs in a fresh Docker container, while the agent reads a repository copy outside it and accesses paused runtime state through HTTP. The launcher mounts the overlay read-only and the results and trace directories writable. Other filesystem locations can remain writable. It attempts container cleanup, but cleanup success and external-resource resets need separate checks. The launcher includes a host-gateway mapping without explicitly disabling network access and setting CPU and memory quotas. Repository commits, image tags, and source hashes are recorded, while hardware, operating system, image digests, and resolved dependencies still require historical configuration records.
paragraphs.zh: 执行环境。 每个仓库都在一个新的 Docker 容器中运行，而智能体则读取容器外部的仓库副本，并通过 HTTP 访问暂停的运行时状态。 启动器以只读方式挂载覆盖层，并以可写方式挂载结果和跟踪目录。 其他文件系统位置可以保持可写。 它会尝试清理容器，但清理成功与否以及外部资源的重置需要分别检查。 启动器包含一个主机-网关映射，但未显式禁用网络访问或设置 CPU 和内存配额。 仓库提交、镜像标签和源哈希会被记录，而硬件、操作系统、镜像摘要和已解析的依赖项仍需历史配置记录。

paragraphs.en: Model and Interaction Settings. The recorded budget is max_call_llm=100 , with adapter-specific counting. Healer counts successful responses, mini-SWE-agent increments before model calls, OpenHands counts action callbacks, and Codex counts completed thread interactions and records a count in its exception branch. Equal configured budgets therefore do not establish equal provider-request counts. mini-SWE-agent sets its native step_limit=0 and cost_limit=0 , leaving the healing session to enforce its budget. Codex denies approval requests, uses a read-only repository sandbox, and disables web search. Neither these repository restrictions nor mini-SWE-agent’s shell write detection isolates the separate runtime execution tool.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与交互设置。 记录下来的预算为 max_call_llm=100，并采用适配器特定的计数方式。 Healer 统计成功响应次数，mini-SWE-agent 在模型调用前进行递增计数，OpenHands 统计操作回调次数，而 Codex 则统计完成的线程交互次数，并在其异常分支中记录计数。 因此，配置相等的预算并不意味着提供商请求次数也相等。mini-SWE-agent 将其原生 step_limit=0 和 cost_limit=0，由修复会话本身来执行预算限制。 Codex 拒绝批准请求，使用只读仓库沙盒，并禁用网页搜索功能。 这些仓库限制以及 mini-SWE-agent 的 shell 写入检测，都无法隔离独立的运行时执行工具。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Cases and Labels. This evaluation expands the risky action detection setting in Section 5 . Its balanced set contains 342 positive and 342 negative configurations. Positive labels indicate an intended dependency from Heal Sources to a protected input, while negative labels indicate intended independence. These safety labels are separate from target-test success. Unsafe healing is the positive class, and Block is the positive prediction. Labels require the healing code, changed runtime state, protected Sink, and dependency evidence. Unresolved dependencies do not establish safety. The configurations form 342 pairs around 62 recorded healing points. paragraphs.en: Independent Checks on Healing Records. Table 5 compares checks on 3,091 executions after excluding 89 incomplete analyses from 3,180 records. paragraphs.en: Across 8,000 repetitions of the same workload, function instrumentation increases median execution time from 2.64127 ms to 2.68943 ms, a relative increase of 1.82%. This result measures instrumentation overhead and excludes source recording and taint analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在 8000 次重复执行相同工作负载的过程中，函数插桩使执行时间的中位数从 2.64127 毫秒增加到 2.68943 毫秒，相对增幅为 1.82%。 该结果衡量的是插桩带来的额外开销，并未包含源代码记录与污染分析。

paragraphs.en: We compare healing code with the intended program behavior, separating additional side effects from healing correctness. These concerns can overlap, but an extra side effect does not by itself establish a failed target test.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将修复代码与预期的程序行为进行比较，从而将额外的副作用与修复的正确性区分开来。 这些关注点可能存在重叠，但仅凭一个额外的副作用本身并不能说明目标测试失败。

paragraphs.en: We inspect the healing code and reference patches to explain how handling a runtime error can introduce additional side effects. Fig. 11 shows cache file deletion and subprocess invocation inside healing code. The reference patches instead correct exception handling without requiring these operations. The cookie example below adds unnecessary information output. These cases distinguish the state changes needed to handle an error from additional filesystem, process, and output effects. Target-test success does not establish the absence of these effects, and whether an operation violates the safety policy depends on the declared protected operations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查修复代码和参考补丁，以说明如何处理运行时错误可能会引入额外的副作用。 图 11 展示了修复代码内部的缓存文件删除和子进程调用。 而参考补丁则无需这些操作即可修正异常处理。 下面的 Cookie 示例添加了不必要的信息输出。 这些案例区分了处理错误所需的状态变化与文件系统、进程和输出方面的额外影响。 目标测试的成功并不能证明这些影响不存在，而某项操作是否违反安全策略则取决于所声明的保护操作。

paragraphs.en: Cache File Deletion. In qutebrowser, BraveAdBlocker.read_cache raises DeserializationError while reading cached filter data. The reference patch corrects exception handling and reports the error without deleting the cache. In Fig. 11 , the Healer submission instead deletes the cache file before reporting the error. The target test checks the error message but does not check whether the file remains. Separate file-preservation checks confirm the deletion side effect. The mini-SWE-agent submission performs the same deletion after converting the path to a string.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存文件删除。 在 qutebrowser 中，BraveAdBlocker.read_cache 在读取缓存的过滤数据时引发了反序列化错误。 参考补丁修正了异常处理，并在不删除缓存的情况下报告错误。 在图 11 中，Healer 提交版本则在报告错误之前删除了缓存文件。 目标测试检查了错误消息，但未验证文件是否仍然存在。 独立的文件保留性检查证实了删除这一副作用。 mini-SWE-agent 提交版本在将路径转换为字符串后执行了相同的删除操作。

paragraphs.en: Additional Subprocess Execution. In Pillow instance test_7929e622 , importing the unavailable olefile package raises ModuleNotFoundError . The reference patch updates exception handling while preserving the exception. As shown in Fig. 11 , the healing code instead calls subprocess.run to execute pip install olefile through the current interpreter. The recorded call fails, so the evidence shows subprocess execution, not successful installation.

sents.en: In Pillow instance test_7929e622 , importing the unavailable olefile package raises ModuleNotFoundError .

paragraphs.en: Unnecessary Cookie Values Printed. In Fig. 12 , the program treats a CookieJar as a dictionary. Iteration produces cookie objects, but the program indexes cookie_dict[name] and raises TypeError . The healing code copies the cookie objects into cookiejar through set_cookie , then prints their names and values. The reference patch instead iterates directly over the cookie objects and keeps the existing cookiejar.set_cookie(cookie) call without adding output. Printing cookie values is unnecessary for the correction and can expose session data. The figure establishes unnecessary printing, not transmission to an external recipient.
paragraphs.zh: 打印了不必要的 Cookie 值。 在图 12 中，该程序将 CookieJar 视为一个字典。 迭代会生成 cookie 对象，但程序通过 cookie_dict[name] 进行索引，从而引发 TypeError。 修复代码通过 set_cookie 将 cookie 对象复制到 cookiejar 中，然后打印它们的名称和值。 参考补丁则直接对 cookie 对象进行迭代，并保留现有的 cookiejar.set_cookie(cookie) 调用，未添加任何输出。 打印 cookie 值对于修正而言是不必要的，且可能暴露会话数据。 该图说明了不必要的打印行为，而非向外部接收者传输数据。

sents.en: Unnecessary Cookie Values Printed.
sents.zh: 打印了不必要的 Cookie 值。

sents.zh: 在图 12 中，该程序将 CookieJar 视为一个字典。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 13 illustrates preservation of state scope and input checks, not verified submissions under the current execution interface.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 说明了当前执行接口下状态范围的保持、输入检查以及未验证的提交。

paragraphs.en: Missing Function. On the left of Fig. 13 , is_terminal() raises NameError when it calls get_ipython() . Wrong healing adds a replacement function to builtins , making it available to other code in the process. Correct healing sets the local variable ip = None without adding a process-wide function. The local value still supports the subsequent check.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失函数。 在图 13 的左侧，当 is_terminal() 调用 get_ipython() 时会引发 NameError。 错误的修复方式会将一个替换函数添加到 builtins 中，使其在该进程的其他代码中可用。 正确的修复方式会将局部变量 ip 设置为 None，而不会添加一个全局可用的函数。 该局部值仍然支持后续的检查。

sents.en: Missing Function.
sents.zh: 缺失函数。

sents.en: On the left of Fig. 13 , is_terminal() raises NameError when it calls get_ipython() .
sents.zh: 在图 13 的左侧，当 is_terminal() 调用 get_ipython() 时会引发 NameError。

sents.zh: 错误的修复方式会将一个替换函数添加到 builtins 中，使其在该进程的其他代码中可用。

sents.zh: 正确的修复方式会将局部变量 ip 设置为 None，而不会添加一个全局可用的函数。

paragraphs.en: Invalid Input. On the right of Fig. 13 , validate_whiskers(s) expects a pair of values, but s = ’1.5’ supplies a single value. Wrong healing returns float(s) and skips the required input check. Correct healing raises ValueError to preserve rejection of the invalid input. Thus, preserving intended behavior can require keeping an exception rather than forcing execution to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 输入无效。 在图 13 的右侧，validate_whiskers(s) 期望一对值，但 s = '1.5' 只提供了一个值。 错误的修复返回了浮点数，并跳过了必需的输入检查。 正确的修复会引发 ValueError，以保留对无效输入的拒绝。 因此，要保留预期的行为，可能需要保留异常，而不是强制程序继续执行。

sents.en: Correct healing raises ValueError to preserve rejection of the invalid input.
sents.zh: 正确的修复会引发 ValueError，以保留对无效输入的拒绝。

sents.en: Thus, preserving intended behavior can require keeping an exception rather than forcing execution to continue.
sents.zh: 因此，要保留预期的行为，可能需要保留异常，而不是强制程序继续执行。

paragraphs.en: These cases motivate separate checks of healing safety and correctness but do not establish that HealGuard blocked the recorded operations.
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例促使我们分别对修复的安全性和正确性进行检查，但并未证明 HealGuard 阻止了所记录的操作。

paragraphs.en: HealBench and HealGuard have limitations in analysis coverage, runtime execution, and evaluation scope.
paragraphs.zh: HealBench 和 HealGuard 在分析覆盖范围、运行时执行和评估范围方面存在局限性。

paragraphs.en: Analysis Coverage. HealGuard depends on source recording, Sink definitions, and the data-flow models used by CodeQL ( CodeQL, 2026 ) . Missing state changes and incomplete call models can hide dependencies. The policy covers explicit data flow rather than general control dependence. Conservative rejection can also block inputs that are independent of healing.
paragraphs.zh: 分析覆盖范围。 HealGuard 依赖于源记录、Sink 定义以及 CodeQL 使用的数据流模型（CodeQL，2026）。 缺失的状态变化和不完全的调用模型可能会隐藏依赖关系。 该策略涵盖明确的数据流，而非一般的控制依赖。 保守的拒绝机制也可能阻止与修复无关的输入。

paragraphs.en: Runtime Constraints. Runtime error healing requires a live process and an accessible crash frame, as in Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Within that process, HealCore’s syntax restrictions do not guarantee that permitted calls have no side effects, and failed submissions can leave state changes behind. Instrumentation also needs to preserve expected exception handling and keep evaluation code outside the healing scope.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时约束。 运行时错误修复需要一个正在运行的进程和一个可访问的崩溃帧，如 Healer（Sun 等人，2026）所示。 在该进程中，HealCore 的语法限制并不能保证允许的调用没有副作用，而且失败的提交可能会留下状态变更。 仪器化还需要保留预期的异常处理机制，并将评估代码置于修复范围之外。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Scope. Uneven repository coverage, partial traces, and adapter-specific budget counting limit comparisons. Target tests check the behavior they cover, while path similarity does not establish semantic equivalence. Provisional simulation labels and the selection of cases for manual review limit how broadly decision accuracy can be generalized. Saved predictions also do not verify that protected operations were prevented.
paragraphs.zh: 评估范围。 不均衡的仓库覆盖、部分追踪以及针对特定适配器的预算计算限制了比较的有效性。 目标测试检验其覆盖的行为，而路径相似性并不能确立语义等价性。 临时模拟标签以及对手动审查案例的选择，限制了决策准确性所能推广的范围。 已保存的预测也无法验证受保护的操作是否确实被阻止。

paragraphs.en: Future Work. Future work should improve source and Sink coverage and reduce unnecessary rejection. It should also contain state changes from failed healing and validate instrumentation when extending support to more repositories and languages. Independently labeled cases and repeated matched executions should assess recovery correctness, prevented operations, component contributions, and runtime overhead. Controlled comparisons should separately examine the contribution of cross-file context.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作。 未来的工作应改进源和汇的覆盖范围，并减少不必要的拒绝。 在将支持扩展到更多仓库和语言时，它还应包含因修复失败而引发的状态变化，并对仪器化进行验证。 独立标记的案例和重复匹配的执行应评估恢复的正确性、被阻止的操作、组件的贡献以及运行时开销。 受控比较应分别考察跨文件上下文所做的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We provide prompt templates, tool schemas, and execution feedback for each healing agent. The linked {Common Prompt} marks where common healing instructions are inserted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个修复智能体提供提示模板、工具模式和执行反馈。 链接的{通用提示}标记了插入通用修复指令的位置。

sents.zh: 我们为每个修复智能体提供提示模板、工具模式和执行反馈。

sents.zh: 链接的{通用提示}标记了插入通用修复指令的位置。

paragraphs.en: Healer ( Sun et al., 2026 ) receives system instructions and user crash context, with final healing submission as its available action.
paragraphs.zh: 修复者（Sun 等人，2026）接收系统指令和用户崩溃上下文，其可用动作是最终的修复提交。

paragraphs.en: mini-SWE-agent ( SWE-agent, 2025 ) appends the common instructions to its native system prefix. Its initial user message adds system information after the crash context. Later crashes reuse the interaction.
paragraphs.zh: mini-SWE-agent（SWE-agent，2025）将其通用指令附加到其原生系统前缀中。 其初始用户消息在崩溃上下文之后添加了系统信息。 后续的崩溃会重复使用该交互。

sents.en: mini-SWE-agent ( SWE-agent, 2025 ) appends the common instructions to its native system prefix.
sents.zh: mini-SWE-agent（SWE-agent，2025）将其通用指令附加到其原生系统前缀中。

sents.en: Its initial user message adds system information after the crash context.
sents.zh: 其初始用户消息在崩溃上下文之后添加了系统信息。

sents.en: Later crashes reuse the interaction.
sents.zh: 后续的崩溃会重复使用该交互。

paragraphs.en: OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) retains its native system prompt and appends the common healing instructions. The native prompt includes general editing and package-installation instructions, while the healing instructions restrict repository use to reading.
paragraphs.zh: OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）保留其原生系统提示，并附加通用的修复指令。 原生提示包含通用的编辑和软件包安装指令，而修复指令则将仓库的使用限制为仅读取。

sents.en: OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) retains its native system prompt and appends the common healing instructions.
sents.zh: OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）保留其原生系统提示，并附加通用的修复指令。

sents.en: The native prompt includes general editing and package-installation instructions, while the healing instructions restrict repository use to reading.
sents.zh: 原生提示包含通用的编辑和软件包安装指令，而修复指令则将仓库的使用限制为仅读取。

paragraphs.en: Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) receives healing instructions and returns JSON through the user-message protocol below, which does not include the SDK system prompt.
paragraphs.zh: Codex（OpenAI，2026）接收修复指令，并通过下述用户消息协议返回 JSON，该协议不包含 SDK 系统提示。

paragraphs.en: The execute tool uses submit=false for runtime state inspection and submit=true for healing submission. The reraise tool propagates the original exception. Neither action undoes earlier side effects.
paragraphs.zh: 执行工具在运行时状态检查时使用 submit=false，在恢复提交时使用 submit=true。 重新抛出工具会传播原始异常。 这两种操作都不会撤销先前的副作用。

sents.en: The execute tool uses submit=false for runtime state inspection and submit=true for healing submission.
sents.zh: 执行工具在运行时状态检查时使用 submit=false，在恢复提交时使用 submit=true。

sents.en: The reraise tool propagates the original exception.
sents.zh: 重新抛出工具会传播原始异常。

sents.en: Neither action undoes earlier side effects.
sents.zh: 这两种操作都不会撤销先前的副作用。

paragraphs.en: The middleware bash tool reads repository code for cross-file context but cannot access live objects in the paused frame. Its read-only instruction does not itself enforce file protection.
paragraphs.zh: 该中间件 bash 工具会读取仓库代码以获取跨文件上下文，但无法访问暂停帧中的实时对象。 其只读指令本身并不会强制执行文件保护。

paragraphs.en: OpenHands Runtime Actions. The adapter records the request, pauses the conversation, and returns an acknowledgement, not a healing result. The definitions inherit SDK fields.
paragraphs.zh: OpenHands 运行时操作。 适配器会记录请求，暂停对话，并返回确认信息，而非修复结果。 这些定义继承了 SDK 字段。

paragraphs.zh: Codex 响应模式。 该模式需要“理由”，但所显示的提示中并未列出此项。

paragraphs.zh: 完成消息报告的是代码执行结果，而非修复的正确性。

paragraphs.en: Feedback and Invalid Responses. Submission errors return to the agent within its budget and timeouts. OpenHands no_submission does not imply deliberate refusal. Codex can extract embedded JSON after parsing fails, without complete schema revalidation being established. Historical inputs are determined by saved requests, not current templates. Requests containing access tokens are not reproduced.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈与无效响应。 提交错误会在智能体的预算和超时限制内返回给智能体。 OpenHands 的 no_submission 并不意味着蓄意拒绝。 在解析失败后，Codex 可以提取嵌入的 JSON，而无需建立完整的模式重新验证。 历史输入由已保存的请求决定，而非当前模板。 包含访问令牌的请求不会被重复生成。
